findings.title: Immediate termination and fee clawback for conflict of interest
findings.deviation: Clause 8.2 permits the Client to terminate immediately and recover all amounts paid if a contractual restriction exists or arises, which deviates from AtliQ's standard requiring payment for all work performed.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks being forced to refund all fees collected for completed work if any contractual restriction arises during the agreement term.
findings.quote: If such a restriction exists or arises, the Client may terminate this Agreement immediately and recover all amounts paid.
findings.counterPosition: Delete the right to recover all amounts paid and specify that upon any termination AtliQ shall be paid for all services performed up to the termination date.

fine.note: Delay penalties are 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the affected milestone fee, matching AtliQ's standard.
Aggregate liability is capped at 1x fees with standard carve-outs for fraud and wilful misconduct.
Deliverables vest upon payment and AtliQ retains background IP, matching AtliQ's standard.
Confidentiality is mutual with a standard 5-year duration.
No indemnity obligations are imposed on AtliQ.
Data protection compliance requirements align with standard expectations.
